review.notes: Full review. Sample: all 15 seeded targets plus 4.1 and the Conventions; every statement recomputed on degenerate instances and every numerical Check recomputed (adversarial table of 22 rows). Sources: 17 Owen locators (chapters 8 and 9, author's page) and Chatterjee-Diaconis Theorem 1.1 with its proof (arXiv v3) read at their pages; all support the statements. 33 Mathlib declarations and TauCeti.covMatrix opened at the pins; supplier sections of MathematicalStatisticsFoundations and MathematicalStatisticsNonparametric resolved on main. Automatic checks all passed, none set aside; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; one-tactic probe closes none of the 20 theorems. Corrections: variance convention fails for non-measurable functions; PACBayesBounds does not exist; one sentence of the description. For humans: main source is an unpublished author-hosted manuscript carrying a no-redistribution notice.
